channel.title: FXStreet Forex & Commodities News
channel.description: Real-time Forex News and the latest trading updates. Stay updated on the latest news about currencies and commodities markets.

item.title: British Pound dips to 207.50 as Japanese Yen rallies, unfazed by Oil prices
item.description: The British Pound (GBP) extends losses on Wednesday as the Japanese Yen (JPY) rallies across the board, with investors bracing for a quarter-point rate hike by the Bank of Japan (BoJ) at next week’s monetary policy meeting.

item.title: Euro: Volatility eyed into late week – Commerzbank
item.description: Commerzbank’s Antje Praefcke notes that EUR/USD is likely to stay relatively quiet until later in the week, when the European Central Bank (ECB) meeting and US inflation data could trigger stronger moves.

item.title: Gold recovers further from one-week low, retakes $4.400 amid sustained USD selling
item.description: Gold (XAU/USD) builds on its intraday recovery from a one-week low and reclaims the $4,400 mark heading into the European session on Wednesday.

item.title: AUD/USD Price Forecast: Approaches four-year high near 0.7280
item.description: The Australian Dollar (AUD) is higher against its major currency peers, except the Japanese Yen (JPY), on Wednesday, trading 0.16% up at around 0.7230 against the US Dollar (USD) during the European session.

item.title: GBP/USD Price Forecast: Strengthens above 1.3550, upside bias intact while holding above 100-day SMA
item.description: The GBP/USD pair trades in positive territory around 1.3550 during the early European trading hours on Wednesday. UK Chancellor John Healey unveiled a series of measures designed to encourage economic growth and draw more private investment into the UK.

item.title: Indian Rupee falls further as US-Iran tit-for-tat strikes boost oil prices
item.description: The Indian Rupee (INR) extends its decline against the US Dollar (USD) on Wednesday after a sharp correction the previous day. The USD/INR pair jumps marginally above 95.00 as surging energy prices have battered the Indian currency significantly.

item.title: EUR/JPY Price Forecast: Softens to near 178.50, retains bearish bias despite oversold RSI
item.description: The EUR/JPY cross trades in negative territory near 178.50 during the early European trading hours on Wednesday.

item.title: Swiss Franc strengthens as US Dollar holds losses despite Fed rate hike odds
item.description: USD/CHF loses ground for the third consecutive day, trading around 0.8090 during the Asian hours on Wednesday. The pair remains subdued as the US Dollar (USD) holds losses despite a hawkish tone surrounding the Federal Reserve (Fed) policy outlook.

item.title: WTI eases from three-month top and slips below $92.00; supply concerns to limit downside
item.description: West Texas Intermediate (WTI) – the benchmark US Crude Oil price – touches a fresh three-month top, around the $92.50 area during the Asian session on Wednesday, though it lacks follow-through. Nevertheless, the commodity seems poised to climb further amid escalating US-Iran tensions.

item.title: India Gold price today: Gold rises, according to FXStreet data
item.description: Gold prices rose in India on Wednesday, according to data compiled by FXStreet.

item.title: EUR/USD Price Forecast: Bullish bias remains above 1.1600 ahead of ECB and US inflation
item.description: The EUR/USD pair attracts fresh buyers during the Asian session on Wednesday, though it lacks bullish conviction and remains confined within the weekly range.

item.title: United States Dollar Index weakens despite rising inflation concerns, Fed rate hike bets
item.description: The US Dollar Index (DXY), which measures the value of the US Dollar (USD) against six major currencies, is losing ground for the third consecutive day and trading around 98.80 during Asian hours on Wednesday.

item.title: Silver Price Forecast: XAG/USD rises to near $66.40 as US Dollar declines, US CPI in focus
item.description: Silver price (XAG/USD) is up almost 1% to near $66.40 during the Asian trading session on Wednesday. The white metal strengthens as the US Dollar remains under pressure despite expectations that the Federal Reserve (Fed) could raise interest rates at the policy meeting next week.

item.title: Japanese Yen gathers strength as BoJ hike bets ramp up
item.description: The USD/JPY pair loses momentum to around 153.55 during the early Asian session on Wednesday. The Japanese Yen (JPY) strengthens against the US Dollar (USD) as Bank of Japan (BoJ) policymakers opened the door for a rate hike in September.

item.title: Canadian Dollar gains amid elevated oil prices, escalating US trade sanctions
item.description: USD/CAD remains subdued for the third successive day, trading around 1.3780 during the Asian hours on Wednesday. The currency pair loses ground as the commodity-linked Canadian Dollar (CAD) draws support from elevated oil prices, given Canada's position as one of the world's leading crude exporters.

item.title: New Zealand Dollar holds gains above 0.5850 after Chinese inflation data
item.description: The NZD/USD pair gathers strength to around 0.5855 during the early Asian trading hours on Wednesday. The New Zealand Dollar (NZD) edges higher against the US Dollar (USD) following Chinese economic data. Traders will keep an eye on the US inflation data later this week.

item.title: Australian Dollar remains on the front foot vs weak USD after China's inflation data
item.description: The AUD/USD pair sticks to its positive bias through the Asian session on Wednesday and trades around the 0.7220-0.7225 area, just below its highest level since May 14, touched the previous day. Spot prices, meanwhile, moved little following the release of China's inflation figures.

item.title: Australian Dollar inches higher against Japanese Yen following China’s inflation data
item.description: AUD/JPY pares its daily losses following the release of key economic data from China, Australia's primary trading partner. However, the currency cross remains in negative territory and is trading around 111.00 during Asian hours on Wednesday.

item.title: 0.8%: China’s CPI inflation rises in August
item.description: China’s Consumer Price Index (CPI) climbed 0.8% in August from a year ago after arriving at a rise of 0.5% in Juuly, the National Bureau of Statistics of China reported on Wednesday. The market consensus was for 0.8% in the reported period.

item.title: US President Donald Trump bans Canadian autos, dairy and alcohol
item.description: US President Donald Trump is banning Canadian products, including alcohol, dairy and motor vehicles, as Canadian retaliatory tariffs on American goods come into force, BBC reported on Tuesday.

item.title: WTI surges as US strikes Iranian tankers
item.description: West Texas Intermediate (WTI) oil price extends its gains for the third successive day, trading around $92.30 during the Asian hours on Wednesday. Crude oil prices rise as the US struck several Iranian tankers near Kharg Island, a major crude export hub.

item.title: PBOC sets USD/CNY reference rate at 6.7769 vs. 6.7804 previous
item.description: On Wednesday, the People’s Bank of China (PBOC) sets the USD/CNY central rate for the trading session ahead at 6.7769 compared to the previous day's fix of 6.7804 and 6.7042 Reuters estimate.

item.title: British Pound holds steady near mid-1.3500s vs USD as traders eye UK GDP and US inflation
item.description: The GBP/USD pair trades with a positive bias near mid-1.3500s during the Asian session on Wednesday, though it lacks bullish conviction and remains confined within the previous day's broader range.

item.title: Euro grinds higher above 1.1600, traders await ECB rate decision, US inflation data
item.description: The EUR/USD pair gains traction to near 1.1630 during the early Asian trading hours on Wednesday. Expectations of a rate hike from the European Central Bank (ECB) provide some support to the Euro (EUR) against the US Dollar (USD). ECB President Christine Lagarde is set to speak later in the day.

item.title: US targets Iranian oil tankers in response to attacks on US ships
item.description: US official said that US forces have struck multiple Iranian tankers tied to Iran’s Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) in response to attempted missile attacks on a US warship, Bloomberg reported on Tuesday.

item.title: Gold slumps to near $4,350 amid oil-driven inflation fears, US inflation data in focus
item.description: Gold price (XAU/USD) falls to near $4,350 during the early Asian session on Wednesday. The precious metal faces some selling pressure as rising oil prices fueled inflation ‌concerns and boosted expectations for a rate hike by the Federal Reserve (Fed) in September.

item.title: Australian Dollar bulls run into Oil wall amid looming Fed decision
item.description: The Aussie Dollar finished Tuesday’s session flat after bouncing off daily lows of 0.7204 but failed to sustain its gains as higher oil prices pushed the Greenback higher, leaving the Aussie Dollar nearly flat, according to the US Dollar Index (DXY).

item.title: The Japanese Yen spikes on a generational wage print and balks by the closing bell
item.description: USD/JPY trades just under 154.00, roughly 40 pips lower on Tuesday after a 147-pip round trip.

item.title: The Pound sits still through a hawkish hearing and the priciest gilt sale
item.description: GBP/USD trades just under 1.3550 after a session that spanned 40 pips and returned two-tenths of a pip.

item.title: USD/JPY Price Forecast: Hammer teases rebound after 650-pip slide
item.description: The USD/JPY continued to fall for the second straight day, losing 0.40%, but found support around 153.00, with the pair set to end the session at around 153.75.
